title: 15 Days Online Ashtanga Vinyasa Course
metaDescription: Bali yoga school are offering Online Yoga Teacher Training course for 15 Days Online Ashtanga Vinyasa Course based yoga teacher training.
summary: This 15 day online yoga course mixes prerecorded videos and live Zoom classes (1.5 hours daily) with teachers from Rishikesh, India.
intro: This 15 day online yoga course mixes prerecorded videos and live Zoom classes (1.5 hours daily) with teachers from Rishikesh, India. You'll learn Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga—a strong, set order of poses that's great for everyone (beginners too!).

You'll also practice teaching others (like friends) during live classes. If you're stuck or have questions, ask the teachers directly in the Zoom sessions. Everything is online, so you can join from home!
